name: Tampa Clothing Company INC.
old_description: Designs in 7 days • Production 2–3 weeks after approval • No minimums • Made in USA
about:
Tampa Clothing Company operates from Hudson, Florida, as a family-owned custom apparel manufacturer. The company produces all-over dye-sublimated garments entirely in the United States and does not outsource any production steps.

The shop focuses on full-color dye sublimation across a catalog of shirts, polos, hoodies, tanks, and fleece items in sizes from youth small to 8X. Design turnaround is quoted at seven days, with production shipping two to three weeks after artwork approval. No minimum order quantities are required, and the company handles design, manufacturing, and fulfillment in-house.

Customers span business and brand launches, event and promotional needs, corporate uniform programs, sports teams requiring jerseys with names and numbers, trades and services such as pressure washing and property maintenance, and schools or groups ordering personalized class and club apparel.

The company emphasizes its family-owned structure, domestic manufacturing, and a no-minimums policy as core differentiators, positioning itself as a partner that takes a project from first sketch to final stitch without leaving U.S. soil.
